1	# Instant Resume Ranker (Rankora)
2	
3	AI-powered resume screening SaaS. Users paste a job description, upload resumes, and the system scores/ranks candidates using GPT-4o.
4	
5	## Stack
6	
7	- **Frontend:** React 18.3 + TypeScript, Vite (dev port 8080), React Router 6
8	- **UI:** Tailwind CSS 3.4 + shadcn-ui, Lucide icons, Sonner toasts, Recharts
9	- **State:** React Query 5 (server state), React Hook Form + Zod (forms)
10	- **Backend:** Supabase (PostgreSQL + Auth + Edge Functions + Storage)
11	- **AI:** OpenAI GPT-4o (resume analysis, JD parsing, scoring)
12	- **Payments:** Dodo Payments (subscriptions + one-time credit packs, hosted checkout)
13	- **Email:** Resend (transactional notifications) + inbound webhook (resume ingestion)
14	- **Vectors:** pgvector extension with HNSW indexes
15	
16	## Folder Structure
17	
18	```
19	src/
20	├── pages/                          # Route pages
21	│   ├── Index.tsx                   # Main dashboard (sidebar + detail view)
22	│   ├── Auth.tsx                    # Login/signup
23	│   ├── Admin.tsx                   # Admin dashboard (role-gated)
24	│   ├── Settings.tsx                # User settings (5 cards)
25	│   └── NotFound.tsx                # 404
26	├── components/
27	│   ├── AppHeader.tsx               # Top nav (credits badge, user menu)
28	│   ├── JobSidebar.tsx              # Left sidebar (job list, search, rename, delete)
29	│   ├── JobDetailView.tsx           # Core component (JD input, file upload, ranking, results) ~760 lines
30	│   ├── CandidateRow.tsx            # Expandable result row (scores, skills, gaps, interview Qs)
31	│   ├── ScoreSummaryCards.tsx        # 4 avg score cards
32	│   ├── AuthDialog.tsx              # Auth modal wrapper
33	│   ├── AuthForm.tsx                # Sign in/up form (email+password, magic link)
34	│   ├── LandingPage.tsx             # Marketing page
35	│   ├── BuyCreditsDialog.tsx        # Credit pack purchase (Dodo Payments hosted checkout)
36	│   ├── SubscriptionDialog.tsx      # Plan subscription (Dodo Payments hosted checkout)
37	│   ├── ProtectedRoute.tsx          # Auth guard (ProtectedRoute + AdminRoute)
38	│   ├── MaintenancePage.tsx         # Maintenance mode display
39	│   ├── SeoHead.tsx                 # Dynamic meta tags
40	│   ├── settings/                   # Settings page cards

99	
100	## Database Models (Supabase/PostgreSQL)
101	
102	- **profiles** — user_id, credits, plan, inbox_email, email_enabled
103	- **jobs** — user_id, job_description, title, status (pending|processing|completed|failed), scoring weights (must/nice/optional), jd_analysis_json, dynamic_weights_json, jd_embedding (vector)
104	- **resumes** — job_id, filename, file_path, candidate_name, status (pending|done|failed), parsed_json, parsed_text, embedding (vector)
105	- **results** — resume_id, job_id, overall_score, skill_score, experience_score, education_score, missing_skills[], red_flags, matched_must_haves, missing_must_haves, category_scores_json, confidence, hard_fit, strengths_json, gaps_json, explanation_json, interview_questions[]
106	- **users / user_roles** — auth + role enum (admin|user), helper: has_role(), is_job_owner()
107	- **plans** — name, price, credits, billing_type, dodo_product_id, active
108	- **credit_packs** — name, price, credits, active, is_trial, dodo_product_id, dodo_credit_entitlement_id
109	- **payments** — user_id, amount, credits_purchased, status, dodo_payment_id
110	- **feature_flags** — key (unique), enabled, label, description, value_json, category
111	- **platform_config** — singleton: max_resumes_per_job, max_file_size_mb, resume_retention_days, email_ingestion_enabled, payg_per_resume_cost
112	- **ranking_config** — system prompt, model name, temperature, weights
113	- **seo_settings / seo_pages** — meta tags, OG, structured data, analytics
114	- **email_templates** — customizable outbound emails
115	- **admin_audit_logs** — admin_user_id, action, entity_type, entity_id, details
116	- **feedback / score_versions** — model evaluation data
117	- **email_ingest_logs** — user_id, job_id, sender, status, attachments_count
118	- **usage_logs** — user_id, job_id, credits_used
119	- **subscription_webhooks** — Dodo Payments webhook audit trail
120	
121	## Component Dependency Map
122	
123	```
124	App.tsx → AuthProvider → QueryClientProvider → BrowserRouter
125	├── Index.tsx
126	│   ├── AppHeader (useAuth, useNavigate)
127	│   ├── JobSidebar (pastJobs[], selectedJobId, onSelectJob, onDeleteJob)
128	│   ├── JobDetailView (useAuth, usePlatformConfig, useFeatureFlags)
129	│   │   ├── ScoreSummaryCards (results[])
130	│   │   ├── CandidateRow (result, resume, expanded, onToggle)
131	│   │   └── AuthDialog → AuthForm
132	│   └── AuthDialog
133	├── Auth.tsx → AppHeader, AuthForm
134	├── Settings.tsx → AppHeader, AccountInfoCard, EmailInboxCard, ChangePasswordCard, UsageHistoryCard, PaymentHistoryCard
135	├── Admin.tsx → AppHeader, AdminSidebar, [DashboardTab|UsersTab|BillingTab|...]
136	└── NotFound.tsx
137	```
138	
139	## Architecture Rules
140	
141	1. **Auth-first:** All data access uses Supabase RLS policies. Never bypass auth.
142	2. **shadcn-ui only:** Use components from `src/components/ui/`. No other UI libraries.
143	3. **Path aliases:** Always import with `@/` prefix (maps to `src/`).
144	4. **React Query:** All server state via React Query hooks. No raw `useEffect` for data fetching.
145	5. **Single Supabase client:** Import from `@/integrations/supabase/client.ts`. Never create new clients.
146	6. **Edge Functions:** Business logic in Supabase Edge Functions (Deno). Frontend calls via `supabase.functions.invoke()`.
147	7. **Credits system:** All ranking operations deduct credits via `deduct_credits()` DB function.
148	8. **Admin audit:** Log all admin mutations via `logAuditAction()` from `@/lib/auditLog.ts`.
149	9. **No hardcoded secrets:** All keys via environment variables (VITE_ prefix for frontend).
150	10. **Auto-generated types:** `src/integrations/supabase/types.ts` is auto-generated. Do not manually edit.
151	11. **Sonner toasts:** Use `toast.success()`, `toast.error()` from sonner. No other notification system.
152	12. **Error handling:** Try-catch with toast for user-facing errors. Validation errors as arrays displayed inline.
153	13. **Real-time subscriptions:** Feature flags and SEO settings use Supabase real-time subscriptions + React Query invalidation.
154	
155	## Key Data Flows
156	
157	### Resume Ranking Pipeline
158	```
159	User enters JD + uploads files
160	→ validateFields() checks input
161	→ Create job record (status: pending)
162	→ analyzeJd() → analyze-jd edge function → stores jd_analysis_json
163	→ uploadFilesFromSnapshot() → Supabase Storage + resume records
164	→ rank-resumes edge function (GPT-4o scoring, skill matching)
165	→ rankAndPoll() polls job.status every 2s (max 60 iterations)
166	→ Fetch results from results table
167	→ Merge with resume data, sort by overall_score desc
168	→ Display ScoreSummaryCards + CandidateRow list
169	→ refreshProfile() updates credit count
170	```
171	
172	### Credit System
173	```
174	Check profiles.credits ≥ required
175	→ deduct_credits(user_id, amount) [atomic DB function]
176	→ Log to usage_logs
177	→ Proceed with AI operation
178	→ On failure: no auto-refund (credits already deducted)
179	```
180	
181	### Payment Flows
182	```
183	One-time: BuyCreditsDialog → create-dodo-checkout → redirect to Dodo hosted checkout → dodo-webhook → add credits → PaymentCallback verifies
184	Subscription: SubscriptionDialog → create-dodo-checkout (subscription product) → Dodo checkout → dodo-webhook → update plan+credits
185	Cancellation: cancel-dodo-subscription → plan active until subscription_ends_at → check-expired-subscriptions (cron) → downgrade to free
186	```
187	
188	## Known Code Patterns
189	
190	- **Polling pattern:** `rankAndPoll()` in JobDetailView uses setInterval with iteration counter
191	- **Ref tracking:** `rankingFilesRef` and `resultsRef` track state outside React lifecycle
192	- **Feature flag defaults:** `useFeatureFlag()` returns `enabled: false` before loading (race condition potential)
193	- **SEO type workaround:** `(supabase as any)` cast for seo_settings/seo_pages (not in auto-generated types)
194	- **Dodo hosted checkout:** Both BuyCreditsDialog and SubscriptionDialog use create-dodo-checkout for redirect-based payment
195	- **Admin section mapping:** `sectionComponents` object in Admin.tsx maps section names to components
196	
197	## Commands
198	
199	```bash
200	npm install          # Install dependencies
201	npm run dev          # Start dev server (localhost:8080)
202	npm run build        # Production build
203	npm run test         # Run tests (Vitest)
204	npm run test:watch   # Watch mode tests
205	npx eslint .         # Lint
206	
207	# Supabase
208	supabase functions deploy <name>
209	supabase db push
210	supabase gen types typescript --project-id zkzontawprihrzpayeam > src/integrations/supabase/types.ts
211	```
212	
213	## Safety Rules (CRITICAL)
214	
215	1. **NEVER delete or overwrite existing data/files without explicit user request**
216	2. **NEVER modify payment/billing logic without careful review** — broken payments = lost revenue
217	3. **NEVER change RLS policies without understanding the full security impact**
218	4. **NEVER modify `types.ts`** — it is auto-generated
219	5. **NEVER hardcode API keys, URLs with secrets, or credentials**
220	6. **ALWAYS run `npm run build` after changes to verify no type errors**
221	7. **ALWAYS preserve existing error handling** — do not remove try-catch blocks
222	8. **ALWAYS maintain backward compatibility** — existing API contracts must not break
223	9. **When in doubt, ask the user** — never guess about business logic
224

1	-- ============================================================
2	-- TASKS + TEAM NOTIFICATIONS
3	-- ============================================================
4	-- Depends on:
5	--   • public.teams, public.team_members        (20260407100000)
6	--   • public.jobs, public.resumes              (initial schema)
7	--   • public.stage_history, public.candidate_notes (20260318160000, 20260407100000)
8	--   • public.notifications                     (20260331000000)
9	--   • public.update_updated_at_column()        (initial schema)
10	--   • public.is_team_member(), public.is_team_admin() (20260407100000)
11	-- ============================================================
12	
13	
14	-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
15	-- 1. TASKS TABLE
16	-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
17	
18	CREATE TABLE public.tasks (
19	  id           uuid        PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
20	  team_id      uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES public.teams(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
21	  title        text        NOT NULL,
22	  description  text,
23	  assigned_to  uuid        REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
24	  created_by   uuid        NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
25	  job_id       uuid        REFERENCES public.jobs(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
26	  resume_id    uuid        REFERENCES public.resumes(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
27	  status       text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'todo'
28	                             CHECK (status IN ('todo', 'in_progress', 'done')),
29	  priority     text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'medium'
30	                             CHECK (priority IN ('low', 'medium', 'high')),
31	  due_date     date,
32	  completed_at timestamptz,
33	  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
34	  updated_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
35	);
36	
37	-- Indexes
38	CREATE INDEX idx_tasks_team        ON public.tasks(team_id);
39	CREATE INDEX idx_tasks_assigned    ON public.tasks(assigned_to);
40	CREATE INDEX idx_tasks_created_by  ON public.tasks(created_by);
41	CREATE INDEX idx_tasks_status      ON public.tasks(team_id, status);
42	CREATE INDEX idx_tasks_due         ON public.tasks(due_date) WHERE status != 'done';
43	
44	-- updated_at trigger (reuses existing function from initial schema)
45	CREATE TRIGGER update_tasks_updated_at
46	  BEFORE UPDATE ON public.tasks
47	  FOR EACH ROW
48	  EXECUTE FUNCTION public.update_updated_at_column();
49	
50	
51	-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
52	-- 2. RLS FOR TASKS
53	-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
54	
55	ALTER TABLE public.tasks ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
56	
57	-- Team members can view all tasks in their team
58	CREATE POLICY "Team members can view tasks"
59	  ON public.tasks FOR SELECT TO authenticated
60	  USING (public.is_team_member(auth.uid(), team_id));
61	
62	-- Team members can create tasks (must be the creator)
63	CREATE POLICY "Team members can create tasks"
64	  ON public.tasks FOR INSERT TO authenticated
65	  WITH CHECK (
66	    created_by = auth.uid()
67	    AND public.is_team_member(auth.uid(), team_id)
68	  );
69	
70	-- Creator, assigned user, or team admin can update
71	CREATE POLICY "Task participants can update"
72	  ON public.tasks FOR UPDATE TO authenticated
73	  USING (
74	    created_by = auth.uid()
75	    OR assigned_to = auth.uid()
76	    OR public.is_team_admin(auth.uid(), team_id)
77	  );
78	
79	-- Creator or team admin can delete
80	CREATE POLICY "Task owners can delete"
81	  ON public.tasks FOR DELETE TO authenticated
82	  USING (
83	    created_by = auth.uid()
84	    OR public.is_team_admin(auth.uid(), team_id)
85	  );
86	
87	
88	-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
89	-- 3. EXTEND notifications.type CHECK CONSTRAINT
90	--    Original auto-generated name is "notifications_type_check"
91	-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
92	
93	ALTER TABLE public.notifications
94	  DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS notifications_type_check;
95	
96	ALTER TABLE public.notifications
97	  ADD CONSTRAINT notifications_type_check
98	  CHECK (type IN (
99	    'ranking_complete',
100	    'ranking_failed',
101	    'credits_low',
102	    'credits_added',
103	    'system',
104	    'stage_changed',
105	    'note_added',
106	    'task_assigned',
107	    'task_completed',
108	    'member_joined'
109	  ));
110	
111	
112	-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
113	-- 4. DB TRIGGERS FOR AUTO-NOTIFICATIONS
114	-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
115	
116	-- ── 4a. Task Assignment Notification ─────────────────────────
117	-- Fires on INSERT or UPDATE of assigned_to.
118	-- Notifies the assigned user when they are assigned to a task,
119	-- provided they are not the creator.
120	-- auth.uid() is NOT used inside SECURITY DEFINER triggers;
121	-- we rely on the columns (created_by / assigned_to) instead.
122	
123	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.notify_task_assigned()
124	RETURNS TRIGGER
125	LANGUAGE plpgsql
126	SECURITY DEFINER
127	SET search_path = public
128	AS $$
129	BEGIN
130	  -- Only proceed if someone is assigned and it is not the creator
131	  IF NEW.assigned_to IS NULL THEN
132	    RETURN NEW;
133	  END IF;
134	
135	  IF NEW.assigned_to = NEW.created_by THEN
136	    RETURN NEW;
137	  END IF;
138	
139	  -- INSERT: always notify
140	  -- UPDATE: only notify if assigned_to changed
141	  IF TG_OP = 'INSERT'
142	     OR (TG_OP = 'UPDATE' AND OLD.assigned_to IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.assigned_to)
143	  THEN
144	    BEGIN
145	      INSERT INTO public.notifications (user_id, type, title, message, metadata)
146	      VALUES (
147	        NEW.assigned_to,
148	        'task_assigned',
149	        'New task assigned',
150	        'You''ve been assigned: ' || LEFT(NEW.title, 100),
151	        jsonb_build_object('task_id', NEW.id, 'job_id', NEW.job_id)
152	      );
153	    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
154	      -- Notification failure must not block the main operation
155	      NULL;
156	    END;
157	  END IF;
158	
159	  RETURN NEW;
160	END;
161	$$;
162	
163	CREATE TRIGGER trg_notify_task_assigned
164	  AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OF assigned_to ON public.tasks
165	  FOR EACH ROW
166	  EXECUTE FUNCTION public.notify_task_assigned();
167	
168	
169	-- ── 4b. Task Completed Notification ──────────────────────────
170	-- Fires when task status transitions to 'done'.
171	-- Notifies the creator.  We cannot reliably call auth.uid() inside a
172	-- SECURITY DEFINER trigger context, so instead we always notify the
173	-- creator unconditionally (the creator completing their own task is
174	-- low-noise and acceptable, and avoids unreliable JWT inspection).
175	
176	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.notify_task_completed()
177	RETURNS TRIGGER
178	LANGUAGE plpgsql
179	SECURITY DEFINER
180	SET search_path = public
181	AS $$
182	BEGIN
183	  IF NEW.status = 'done' AND OLD.status != 'done' THEN
184	    BEGIN
185	      INSERT INTO public.notifications (user_id, type, title, message, metadata)
186	      VALUES (
187	        NEW.created_by,
188	        'task_completed',
189	        'Task completed',
190	        'Task completed: ' || LEFT(NEW.title, 100),
191	        jsonb_build_object('task_id', NEW.id)
192	      );
193	    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
194	      NULL;
195	    END;
196	  END IF;
197	
198	  RETURN NEW;
199	END;
200	$$;
201	
202	CREATE TRIGGER trg_notify_task_completed
203	  AFTER UPDATE OF status ON public.tasks
204	  FOR EACH ROW
205	  EXECUTE FUNCTION public.notify_task_completed();
206	
207	
208	-- ── 4c. Stage Change Notification ────────────────────────────
209	-- Fires on INSERT into stage_history.
210	-- Notifies every team member of the job's team except the person
211	-- who made the change (stage_history.changed_by).
212	
213	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.notify_stage_changed()
214	RETURNS TRIGGER
215	LANGUAGE plpgsql
216	SECURITY DEFINER
217	SET search_path = public
218	AS $$
219	DECLARE
220	  _team_id        uuid;
221	  _job_title      text;
222	  _candidate_name text;
223	  _member         record;
224	BEGIN
225	  -- Get job's team_id and title
226	  SELECT j.team_id, j.title
227	  INTO   _team_id, _job_title
228	  FROM   public.jobs j
229	  WHERE  j.id = NEW.job_id;
230	
231	  IF _team_id IS NULL THEN
232	    RETURN NEW;
233	  END IF;
234	
235	  -- Get candidate name
236	  SELECT r.candidate_name
237	  INTO   _candidate_name
238	  FROM   public.resumes r
239	  WHERE  r.id = NEW.resume_id;
240	
241	  -- Notify each team member except the person who changed the stage
242	  FOR _member IN
243	    SELECT tm.user_id
244	    FROM   public.team_members tm
245	    WHERE  tm.team_id = _team_id
246	      AND  tm.user_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.changed_by
247	  LOOP
248	    BEGIN
249	      INSERT INTO public.notifications (user_id, type, title, message, metadata)
250	      VALUES (
251	        _member.user_id,
252	        'stage_changed',
253	        'Stage updated',
254	        COALESCE(_candidate_name, 'Candidate')
255	          || ' moved to ' || NEW.to_stage
256	          || ' in ' || COALESCE(_job_title, 'a job'),
257	        jsonb_build_object(
258	          'job_id',    NEW.job_id,
259	          'resume_id', NEW.resume_id,
260	          'stage',     NEW.to_stage
261	        )
262	      );
263	    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
264	      NULL;
265	    END;
266	  END LOOP;
267	
268	  RETURN NEW;
269	END;
270	$$;
271	
272	CREATE TRIGGER trg_notify_stage_changed
273	  AFTER INSERT ON public.stage_history
274	  FOR EACH ROW
275	  EXECUTE FUNCTION public.notify_stage_changed();
276	
277	
278	-- ── 4d. Note Added Notification ──────────────────────────────
279	-- Fires on INSERT into candidate_notes.
280	-- Notifies all team members of the job's team except the author.
281	
282	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.notify_note_added()
283	RETURNS TRIGGER
284	LANGUAGE plpgsql
285	SECURITY DEFINER
286	SET search_path = public
287	AS $$
288	DECLARE
289	  _team_id        uuid;
290	  _job_title      text;
291	  _candidate_name text;
292	  _member         record;
293	BEGIN
294	  -- Get job's team_id and title
295	  SELECT j.team_id, j.title
296	  INTO   _team_id, _job_title
297	  FROM   public.jobs j
298	  WHERE  j.id = NEW.job_id;
299	
300	  IF _team_id IS NULL THEN
301	    RETURN NEW;
302	  END IF;
303	
304	  -- Get candidate name

-- ============================================================
-- MENTIONS SUPPORT FOR CANDIDATE NOTES
-- ============================================================
-- Depends on:
--   • public.candidate_notes            (20260407100000)
--   • public.notifications              (20260331000000)
--   • public.jobs                       (initial schema)
-- ============================================================

-- Add mentions column to candidate_notes
ALTER TABLE public.candidate_notes ADD COLUMN mentions uuid[] DEFAULT '{}';

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- Extend notifications type constraint to include 'mention'
-- (Drop the one added by 20260407200000 and recreate with mention)
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

ALTER TABLE public.notifications DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS notifications_type_check;

ALTER TABLE public.notifications ADD CONSTRAINT notifications_type_check
  CHECK (type IN (
    'ranking_complete',
    'ranking_failed',
    'credits_low',
    'credits_added',
    'system',
    'stage_changed',
    'note_added',
    'task_assigned',
    'task_completed',
    'member_joined',
    'mention'
  ));

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- Trigger function: notify mentioned users on note insert
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.notify_mentions()
RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
DECLARE
  mentioned_id uuid;
  job_title    text;
BEGIN
  -- Skip if no mentions or empty array
  IF NEW.mentions IS NULL OR array_length(NEW.mentions, 1) IS NULL THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  -- Get job title for the notification message
  SELECT j.title INTO job_title
  FROM   public.jobs j
  WHERE  j.id = NEW.job_id;

  -- Create a notification for each mentioned user (excluding the note author)
  FOREACH mentioned_id IN ARRAY NEW.mentions
  LOOP
    IF mentioned_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.author_id THEN
      BEGIN
        INSERT INTO public.notifications (user_id, type, title, message, metadata)
        VALUES (
          mentioned_id,
          'mention',
          'You were mentioned in a note',
          'Someone mentioned you in a note on ' || COALESCE(job_title, 'a job'),
          jsonb_build_object(
            'job_id',    NEW.job_id,
            'resume_id', NEW.resume_id,
            'note_id',   NEW.id
          )
        );
      EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
        -- Never block note creation due to notification failure
        NULL;
      END;
    END IF;
  END LOOP;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

CREATE TRIGGER on_note_mention
  AFTER INSERT ON public.candidate_notes
  FOR EACH ROW
  EXECUTE FUNCTION public.notify_mentions();

COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.notify_mentions() IS 'Creates mention notifications for each user mentioned in a candidate note, skipping the note author.';
